text: {"hypotheses":[{"statement":"Integrating MemGPT’s virtual context paging (external memory with on‑demand loading) as a rewrite‑style consolidation step will prevent the accuracy drop seen after ~40 items in the ICLR streaming‑memory experiment, because paging provides the same bounded‑memory effect that the bounded‑memory variant achieved.","confidence":0.78,"support_ids":["390f7816","df71618a","4779d9cd","98edf81f"],"tags":["memory‑rewrite","paging","interference‑mitigation"]},{"statement":"The ~40‑item performance cliff in the append‑only baseline reflects a parallel to human episodic memory capacity limits reported in the episodic memory survey, implying that LLM agents inherit similar working‑set constraints; periodic consolidation (as shown in the consolidation‑reduces‑interference paper) acts like hippocampal replay to overcome this bottleneck.","confidence":0.71,"support_ids":["390f7816","c7a6892a","98edf81f"],"tags":["cognitive‑analogy","capacity‑limit","consolidation"]}]}
